title: dipterostemon capitatus subsp. pauciflorus
intro: Dipterostemon capitatus subsp. pauciflorus, commonly known as Pauciflorus, is a plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Pauciflorus include analgesic, antibacterial, and antifungal activities, as well as its ability to modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
